plan.notes: Official YCCC 2025/2026 College Catalog (PDF), Criminal Justice Curriculum Requirements, 61 credits, with the live on-campus program sequencing (fall starts). The catalog also publishes online and part-time sequencing variants (not transcribed). Choice slot transcribed first-listed: MAT 118 over MAT 124. The three 3-credit Program Elective slots are transcribed as generic blocks per wave38 Brevard precedent; per the catalog, any CJS course plus PSY 226 (Forensic Psychology), PSY 228 (Addiction and Substance Abuse), and PSY 230 (Abnormal Psychology) may be used, and at least 6 of the 9 elective credits must carry a CJS prefix.
